description: List state 529 savings plans, ranked by popularity and ratings, with fees, Morningstar and Saving For College ratings, state tax benefit and whether residents of other states can join. Filter by state, by plans anyone can open, by maximum yearly fee, or by minimum rating.

direct_sold_only.description: Only plans you can open yourself, without an advisor

limit.description: How many to return. Default 10, up to 30.

max_fee_percent.description: Highest yearly asset-based fee, in percent, e.g. 0.3

open_to_nonresidents.description: Only plans that people from any state can open

state.description: Two-letter state code, e.g. 'UT'. Returns that state's plans.

top_rated.description: Only plans with a Morningstar medal or a 4.5+ Saving For College rating

name: list_529_plans
title: List state 529 plans
